judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Provide various ML “model” definitions attributed to prominent books/courses/people; (2) Include multiple distinct source-based definitions. The term...”, [2] “In machine learning, various...”, [3] “In the realm of machine...”, [4] “Certainly! Here are a few...”.
